data.name: Immunity to Magic
data.description: A clockwork golem is immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance.  In addition, certain spells and effects function differently against a clockwork golem, as noted below.  A grease spell cast on the golem causes it to move quickly for 1d6 rounds, as if under the effects of haste.  A rusting grasp spell deals damage to a clockwork golem normally, and makes the golem staggered for 1d6 rounds (no save).
